name: hdie_pc_ctrl_cfg

job.purpose: H2 uses registered physical bank onehots for both oldest-write ACT and current queue PRE exclusion, removing remaining1669-load rotated rp network with no normal edges/extra state; full same-cycle policy and full service proof retained. Replace measured H1 TritonCTS97.7ps spread with supported explicit equal-delay balanced clock spine, including each real SRAM clock as its own leaf, preserving all timing constraints/ports/outline. Clock delay/area and setup require fresh measurement; H1 is unqualified at setup-122.9ps.

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers its boundary itself (OREG: every PHY command output from a flop; KREG: K request in a 2-entry pin skid, k_rdy from a register; KRREG: K response from a 2-entry skid; RREG: PHY return valid+data captured at the pin; pc_id/refresh_reload straps captured in pc_id_q/refresh_reload_q). Flow pin registers would add a cycle inside the elastic K ready/valid handshake (HBM-stack boundary, owner 10-14) and overflow the skids.
